firstPlayerRule: The Corporation (Corp) player always takes the first turn of the game. The Corp and the Runner then alternate turns.
clarifications: At setup, the players decide who will play as the Runner and who will play as the Corporation; whoever takes the Corporation goes first.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the Core Set rulebook from Fantasy Flight Games' support CDN (https://images-cdn.fantasyflightgames.com/ffg_content/android-netrunner/support/android-netrunner-core-rules.pdf), SHA-256 e07e9076e7e7da7c90f079ae5e7f5e695d49f93b457d9a069a69077d7f8393f1, and extracted the text of all 36 PDF pages. PDF page 5, Setup step 1, Choose Sides: the players decide who will play as the Runner and who will play as the Corporation. PDF page 12, Playing the Game: the Corporation and the Runner alternate taking turns; the Corporation always takes the first turn of the game. PDF page 34 credits original game design Richard Garfield and development Lukas Litzsinger; component art carries copyright 2012 Wizards of the Coast LLC / FFG, matching BGG 124742. Also checked the Revised Core Set Rules Reference v1.1 (2018, SHA-256 080d5727043a9438078deabe2ac75924897a9e9c965df23f255b4ccda5cc70a0); it shows the same Corp-turn structure but no contradicting first-turn rule was found. Printed folios were not confirmed in the text extract, so PDF positions are cited. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: Fantasy Flight Games has ended the product; later community-run versions of Netrunner were not checked.
